title: Evaluating the Feasibility of Collecting User Interaction Data at the Emory Autism Center Using MapHabit Software
official: Evaluating the Feasibility of Collecting User Interaction Data at the Emory Autism Center Using MapHabit Software
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the impact of the MapHabit System on autistic transition-age youth (ages 18-24) as they navigate key life transitions including graduating from high school, entering adult services, pursuing employment or education, and community-based living.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 -24 years old at time of enrollment
* Documented diagnosis of Autism, confirmed through prior clinical evaluation and diagnostic reports
* Ability to provide informed consent independently or availability of legally authorized representative

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children
* Inability to provide consent or lack of availability of a legally authorized representative
* Active crisis requiring intensive intervention
